envelope.description: Call the sync from implement, validate and the daemon method

body.title: Call the sync from implement, validate and the daemon method
body.summary: Add src/daemon/tracker-sync-comments.ts with handleTrackerSyncComments and a best-effort runner for a Task, register tracker.syncComments in src/daemon/index.ts, and call the runner from src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/implement.ts and validate.ts, reporting a short result in the phase's answer and never failing the phase.
acceptanceChecks: Implement and validate run the sync for the Task and name what it recorded and posted in their result
tracker.syncComments runs the sync for the named unit on request and returns its result, or an error that says why nothing was attempted
A failing sync, or a repository with no tracker, leaves implement and validate working as before

tests.name: comment-sync-callers.test.ts: implement and validate run the comment sync for the Task and the daemon method tracker.syncComments runs it on request, and neither is failed by it
